title: Change to give back
prompt: A customer pays some money for something that costs a certain amount. Return the change they should get back.
signature: func solve(paid: float, cost: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(paid: float, cost: float) -> float:
	return 0.0
hint: Which parameter is bigger in a normal purchase? Subtract the other one from it.
solution:
func solve(paid: float, cost: float) -> float:
	return paid - cost
